title.narrative: Enhancing rural education as a means of promoting education for sustainable development

description.narrative: Through this initiative, UNESCO SJO will consolidate the work of the last 5 years in rural education in all Central American countries and Colombia, positioning it not only as an area of gaps, but also an environment of opportunities for pedagogical innovation following the ESD for 2030 framework, the 2023 Recommendation and the SDG 4 target 4.7. This initiative will consist primarily in the development of a free MOOC for education stakeholders in different sectors, educators, policy makers, among others, which will be built on research activities for data collection and identification of promising practices which have contributed to reduce the gaps in the access, exercise and continuity of education trajectories with significant and pertinent learning achievements.
